decision: register a new study with 15 seeds before any test evaluation
rule: Before freeze, run dev-precision. It splits the development-bank primary interaction into between-run and episode-sampling variance and projects the test-bank 95% half-width. It uses variance only, never the effect estimate. If the projection with the current seeds exceeds precision_target_pp, register a new study with the smallest seed count up to max_training_seeds that meets it, within the approved budget, plus a new test bank; this study's test bank then stays unopened.
note: Variance components only drive the decision; development effects are recorded for transparency.
